research.title: Probability Calibration Under Class Imbalance
bullets: Implemented assigned preprocessing and logistic regression routines for tabular classification experiments using specified class proportions and fixed training splits.
Generated reliability diagrams and computed Brier scores for prescribed calibration settings, checking evaluation scripts against supplied examples and documenting discrepancies.

work.title: Inventory and Order Processing Support
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing lists, recorded stock discrepancies, and routed damaged or missing items for follow-up.
Prepared order paperwork, maintained filing records, and coordinated pickup schedules with staff to support routine daily operations.

projects.title: Regularized Regression Baselines for Housing Price Prediction
bullets: Implemented ordinary least squares and ridge regression baselines with scikit-learn, applying median imputation and feature standardization within training pipelines.
Selected regularization settings through cross-validation and compared held-out prediction errors, inspecting residual plots for systematic differences across price ranges.
